news_items.headline: Fastly stock plunges ~39% after Q1 print despite beat-and-raise; core delivery volumes disappoint
news_items.summary: FSLY fell 39.4% in its biggest one-day percentage drop ever after Q1 results. Despite revenue of $173M (+~20% YoY), adjusted EPS 50% above consensus, and raised FY26 guidance to $710M-$725M, the core delivery business showed weaker QoQ volumes than expected with stable pricing. Stock had rallied ~270% in the prior three months, setting expectations too high.

news_items.headline: FSLY on track for biggest one-day percentage drop ever; retail buys the dip
news_items.summary: Stocktwits coverage notes FSLY shares set a record one-day drop following Q1 results. Retail sentiment on the platform leaned bullish on the dip, but the magnitude of the decline reflects institutional repositioning.

news_items.headline: Piper Sandler cuts FSLY price target after core delivery slowdown
news_items.summary: Piper Sandler lowered its FSLY price target citing the core delivery slowdown that crushed the Q1 print. Action follows the Q1 earnings release.

news_items.headline: DA Davidson cuts Fastly price target on network services slowdown
news_items.summary: DA Davidson reduced its FSLY price target, citing slowing network services growth as the basis for the downward revision. Adds to a wave of post-earnings analyst cuts.

news_items.headline: Fastly issues / updates FY 2026 earnings guidance
news_items.summary: Fastly released updated FY2026 guidance projecting total revenue between $710M and $725M, raised from prior outlook. Issued alongside Q1 results.

news_items.headline: Fastly Q1 security revenue +47% YoY to $38.8M; fourth consecutive quarter of accelerating security growth
news_items.summary: Security segment grew 47% YoY to $38.8M, representing 22% of total revenue and the fourth straight quarter of accelerating growth. Diversification away from core delivery is the bull narrative offsetting delivery weakness.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Piper Sandler cut PT (2026-05-07) citing core delivery slowdown; DA Davidson cut PT (2026-05-07) citing network services slowdown. Consensus 3 Buy / 7 Hold / 1 Sell; PT range $8-$20.

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 just reported (~2026-05-06). Revenue $173M (+~20% YoY), adjusted EPS 50% above consensus, FY26 guide raised to $710M-$725M, security revenue +47% YoY. Despite the beat-and-raise, stock fell ~39% as core delivery QoQ volumes disappointed elevated expectations from a 270% three-month rally. Next earnings expected early Aug 2026 (Q2 cadence).
